{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Emerald green velvet sheath dress, empire waist, midi length (just above the ankle), hex #50C878, rich woven velvet.
Silver metallic clutch bag, structured rectangular shape, short handle, hex #E8E8E8, smooth faux leather.
Gold drop earrings, medium drop length, hex #FFD700, polished brass metal.
Nude pointed-toe pumps, classic silhouette, mid-height heel (approx 3 inches), hex #F5D0B9, soft calfskin leather.

This outfit works because the emerald velvet fabric exudes elegance and warmth suitable for an autumn evening at the theater, instantly elevating the look from casual to formal without feeling stiff. The midi length and empire waist create a flattering silhouette that moves gracefully with the flow of a play while maintaining modesty and sophistication expected for a social evening event. Complementing the deep green dress with silver metallic accents and nude shoes ensures the focus remains on the wearer's presence rather than overwhelming the space, striking the perfect balance between artistic expression and refined dress code."}
